def cache_sim(capacity, ttl, ops):
    from collections import OrderedDict
    
    cache = OrderedDict()
    write_times = {}
    results = []
    
    for op in ops:
        if op[0] == 'put':
            _, t, key, value = op
            # Remove expired entries
            keys_to_delete = [k for k in cache if write_times[k] + ttl <= t]
            for k in keys_to_delete:
                del cache[k]
                del write_times[k]
            
            # If key exists, remove it (will re-add at end to make most recently used)
            if key in cache:
                del cache[key]
            # If cache is full, evict LRU
            elif len(cache) >= capacity:
                lru_key = next(iter(cache))
                del cache[lru_key]
                del write_times[lru_key]
            
            # Add the new entry
            cache[key] = value
            write_times[key] = t
        
        elif op[0] == 'get':
            _, t, key = op
            # Check if entry exists and is not expired
            if key in cache and write_times[key] + ttl > t:
                # Move to end (most recently used)
                cache.move_to_end(key)
                results.append(cache[key])
            else:
                results.append(-1)
    
    return results
